[RLOW.6.1.6] **`Duration`-valued arithmetic neither goes negative nor wraps.**
A `Duration` is held as nanoseconds and is never negative ([LTIM.1.3.1]), and
the integer operations do not stop at zero ([LEXP.7.13.1]). The compiler must
lower `a - b` with two `Time` or two `Duration` operands, `dur / n` and
`dur // n` to `FN_MAX(<the integer operation>, 0)`
(`proto/builtin_fn.proto#BuiltinFn`), and its constant folder must fold each to
the value that lowering computes ([LDET.3.3a.8]). `Date - Date` saturates
inside `FN_DATE_DIFF` ([RLOW.6.1.5], [LTIM.4.2.3]).

The compiler must lower `a + b` with two `Duration` operands to
`FN_DURATION_ADD(a, b)`, and `n * dur` and `dur * n` to `FN_DURATION_MUL(n, dur)`,
folded the same way, and must not lower them to integer arithmetic. The engine
evaluates each exactly: an exact result above $2^{63} - 1$ raises as [LTIM.4.1.1]
states, a negative `FN_DURATION_MUL` result yields `0`, and a negative
`FN_DURATION_ADD` result raises the same. The compiler must lower a `sum` read
`r` over a slot of the `time` dimension to `FN_DURATION_ADD(r, 0)` ([LSER.17.2]).

With a `Float` operand `f`, the compiler must lower `dur * f`, `f * dur`,
`dur / f` and `dur // f` to `FN_MAX(FN_ROUND(<the Float operation>), 0)`, folded
the same way. `FN_ROUND` raises what [LTIM.4.1.1] states. `a % b`, `a / b` and
`a // b` with two `Duration` operands lower as on two `Int`s. A `Duration?` read
of [LSER.17.2] lowers to `IF(r is null, r, FN_ROUND(r))`, with `r` the read.

The engine's subtraction of two `Time` operands must not wrap ([LTIM.4.1.1]). An
exact result below the integer range reaches `FN_MAX` as a negative value, and
one above it raises before `FN_MAX` runs.

**A `null` operand still yields `null`** ([LNUL.4.1]), and `FN_MAX` faults on
one. So where an operand's static type is nullable, the compiler must lower the
operation to `IF(x is null, x, FN_MAX(x, 0))`, with `x` the integer operation or
the `FN_ROUND`, and lowers it to the bare `FN_MAX(x, 0)` only where neither operand is nullable.
`FN_DURATION_ADD` and `FN_DURATION_MUL` yield `null` on a `null` operand themselves.
